name: code-block
useFor: Use when you need shadcn's composable code block: a header with CodeBlockTitle and CodeBlockActions (CodeBlockCopyButton), CodeBlockContent with code as a string, and an optional CodeBlockFooter. Pass dark on CodeBlock for code that runs, lineNumbers and highlight on the content. For a single snippet, CodeWindow does the same in one part.
constraints: A full syntax theme with many colors
A dark bar over light code
source: opencommerce-agentcard-web src/components/code-block.tsx; code-window.tsx (the same window, bar, tokenizer and colors)
title: Code Block
description: shadcn's code block as the brand's code window: the mist bar with the file name and Copy, the 13px mono body, light or on ink, with line numbers and banded lines.
